I'm Reza and this is my personal website.
You can have an overview of my interests, skills and projects.

I'm currently working in the ManyAnalysts Project with Dr. Katharina Paul and also the CMDM Lab (PI: Prof. Dr. Sebastian Gluth) at University of Hamburg. My own research is on person perception and meta-accuracy of face trait inferences under supervision of Prof. Dr. Juliane Degner & Prof. Dr. Jenny Wagner.
